sicily.br: Kamikaze near Cefalù (point, intermediate-expert, Oct-Mar); Caos near Agrigento (beach, intermediate, Oct-Mar); Palermo beaches (beach, beginner, Oct-Mar)
sicily.hz: Submerged rocks at Kamikaze, strong winds, long drives to isolated breaks
sicily.sz: 1-3 ft; 5-10 ft in strong winter storms
sicily.tp: 57-82 F, 4/3 mm wetsuit in winter, rash vest in summer

havana.br: La Setenta in Havana (reef, intermediate-expert, Nov-Apr); Playas del Este and El Bajo (beach, beginner, Nov-Apr); Yumuri near Baracoa (river mouth, intermediate, Dec-Mar)
havana.hz: Shallow reef at La Setenta, hurricane swells, jellyfish, shifty currents, no rescue or repair services
havana.sz: 1-3 ft; up to 8 ft in strong northeast swells
havana.pm: Surfing is not recognised as a sport by the government, but visitors are unlikely to be stopped; bring your own board because rentals are scarce

marlborough-abel-tasman.br: Kekerengu north of Kaikoura (point, intermediate, Jun-Aug); Rarangi (beach, beginner-intermediate, year-round)
marlborough-abel-tasman.hz: Rips, dumpy shorebreak and driftwood at Rarangi, rocky entries, long rough access roads
marlborough-abel-tasman.sz: 2-4 ft; bigger on strong southeast swells
marlborough-abel-tasman.tp: 51-65 F, 4/3 mm wetsuit in summer, 5/4 mm hooded in winter

iceland.br: Thorlákshöfn (point, expert, year-round); Sandvík (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr); Grindavík (reef, intermediate-expert, Sep-Mar)
iceland.hz: Boulders and slippery rocks, strong rips and winds, extreme cold, short winter daylight
iceland.tp: 43-50 F, 5/4 mm hooded wetsuit with gloves and boots (6/5 mm in the coldest months)

rajaampat.hz: Reef, remote with no rescue services, sudden squalls, strong currents
rajaampat.pm: Everyone entering Raja Ampat Marine Park pays an environmental fee (about 700,000 rupiah); surf is by charter boat only

vietnam.br: My Khe at Da Nang (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Mar); Back Beach at Vung Tau (beach, beginner, Nov-Mar); Bai Dai at Nha Trang (beach, beginner, Oct-Apr)
vietnam.hz: Strong rips, heavy shorebreak on big days, typhoon swells

seychelles.br: Anse Intendance (beach, beginner-intermediate, May-Oct); Anse Bougainville (reef, expert, year-round)
seychelles.hz: Strong rips and undertow, rocks in the lineup, long paddle out at Bougainville

fjords.br: Hoddevik on the Stad Peninsula (beach, beginner-intermediate, May-Nov); Jæren beaches (beach, beginner-intermediate, year-round)
fjords.hz: Very cold water, shipwreck debris exposed at some tides at Hoddevik, strong currents, remote with no rescue
fjords.sz: 2-5 ft; closes out above 5-6 ft at Hoddevik
fjords.tp: 41-63 F, 4/3 mm in summer, 5/4 mm hooded with boots and gloves in winter (6/5 mm in the coldest months)

lofoten.br: Unstad (beach, intermediate-expert, Sep-Apr); Flakstad (beach, intermediate-expert, Sep-Apr)
lofoten.hz: Extreme cold, no rescue services at remote breaks, strong rips, long flat spells in summer, short winter daylight
lofoten.tp: 39-57 F, 4/3 mm in summer, 5/4 mm hooded with boots and gloves in winter (6/5 mm in the coldest months)

scottish-highlands-skye.br: Thurso East (reef, expert, Oct-Mar); Thurso beach break (beach, beginner-intermediate, Oct-Mar)
scottish-highlands-skye.hz: Sharp slate reef, strong Pentland Firth currents, hard exits in heavy swell, extreme cold, short winter days
scottish-highlands-skye.tp: 43-57 F, 5/4 mm or 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit with gloves and boots from October to April

charleston-savannah.br: Folly Beach and The Washout (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Dec); Tybee Island piers (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Dec)
charleston-savannah.hz: Pier pilings and rock groins, rips, local beach restrictions
charleston-savannah.tp: 52-84 F, 4/3 mm wetsuit in winter, boardshorts in summer
charleston-savannah.pm: At Folly Beach a leash is required, no surfing within 200 ft of the pier, and from May 15 to Sept 15 surfing is banned 10 am-5 pm between 2nd St East and 3rd St West

aruba.hz: Strong currents and high waves at Boca Grandi and Andicuri, rugged rocky coast

palau.br: Santa Maria at Angaur (reef, intermediate-expert, Dec-Mar); West Passage near Babeldaob (reef, intermediate-expert, Nov-Mar)
palau.hz: Shallow reef, rocks, sharks, rips, long boat trips in rough seas

turks-caicos.br: Barrier reef breaks off the north and west coasts of Providenciales (reef, intermediate-expert, Nov-Mar)
turks-caicos.hz: Shallow reef, hard paddles out, messy in big swell, unlicensed water-sports operators

colombian-caribbean.br: Costeño Beach (beach, beginner, Dec-Mar); Palomino (beach, beginner-intermediate, Dec-Mar); El Muelle at Puerto Colombia (beach, expert, Dec-Mar)
colombian-caribbean.hz: Strong currents at Palomino, powerful waves at El Muelle
colombian-caribbean.sz: 2-4 ft; up to 6 ft at the San Bernardo Islands

barbados.br: Soup Bowl at Bathsheba (reef, expert, Oct-Mar); Freights Bay (reef, beginner-intermediate, Oct-Mar); South Point (reef, intermediate, Oct-Mar)
barbados.hz: Shallow dead-coral reef at Soup Bowl, sea urchins, heavy hollow water, barracuda, fast-changing conditions
barbados.sz: 2-5 ft; 7+ ft at Soup Bowl in winter swell

sardinia.br: Capo Mannu (point, expert, Oct-Mar); Porto Ferro (beach, beginner-intermediate, Oct-Mar); Buggerru (beach, intermediate, Oct-Mar)
sardinia.hz: Sharp rocks, rips and a narrow entry and exit at Capo Mannu, sea urchins, strong currents near the cliffs at Porto Ferro
sardinia.sz: 2-5 ft; up to 13 ft in exceptional mistral storms
sardinia.tp: 55-79 F, 3/2 mm wetsuit in summer, 4/3 mm in winter (5/4 mm in January-February)

kerala.br: Varkala (point, beginner-intermediate, Oct-Apr); Kovalam (point, intermediate, Oct-Apr); Kappil (beach, beginner, Oct-Apr)
kerala.hz: Fickle beach breaks, rough seas and currents in the monsoon, boulder seawalls at Kappil, some water pollution at Varkala

guatemala.br: Sipacate (beach, beginner-intermediate, year-round); El Paredón (beach, beginner-expert depending on swell, year-round); Champerico (point, expert, May-Oct)
guatemala.hz: Strong rips, powerful waves in the big season, slow rough roads between breaks
guatemala.sz: 3-6 ft; bigger in the wet season (June-October)

madagascar.br: Anakao's Flameballs and Jelly Baby (reef, intermediate-expert, Apr-Oct); Lavanono (point, intermediate, Apr-Oct); Fort Dauphin (beach, intermediate, May-Sep)
madagascar.hz: Shallow coral at low tide, long boat or road trips to the breaks, wrecks at Fort Dauphin, cyclone storms from November to March
madagascar.tp: 73-84 F, boardshorts to a 3/2 mm wetsuit in the southern winter

galapagos.br: Punta Carola (reef, intermediate, Nov-Apr); El Cañón (point, intermediate-expert, Nov-Apr); La Lobería (reef, expert, Nov-Apr); Tongo Reef (reef, expert, Nov-Apr)
galapagos.hz: Shallow reef and rocks, sea lions in the lineup, fast hollow waves, boat-only breaks
galapagos.sz: 3-6 ft; up to 9 ft on strong north swells
galapagos.tp: 68-80 F, boardshorts or a springsuit in summer, 3/2 mm wetsuit in the cooler months
galapagos.pm: Breaks inside protected areas need permits; the San Cristóbal surf association can arrange permits and transport, and Punta Carola needs none

douro-valley-porto.br: Matosinhos (beach, beginner, year-round); Leça da Palmeira (beach, intermediate, Oct-Mar); Espinho (beach, beginner-intermediate, year-round)
douro-valley-porto.hz: Water pollution at Matosinhos and Leça, strong rips, breakwater rocks, cold water
douro-valley-porto.tp: 59-68 F, 4/3 mm wetsuit (3/2 mm in summer)

copenhagen.br: Klitmøller, the Cold Hawaii coast on the west of Jutland, a long drive from the city (beach, beginner-intermediate, year-round)
copenhagen.hz: Very cold water, constant wind, a long trip from the city
copenhagen.tp: 35-68 F, 5/4 mm hooded wetsuit with boots and gloves in winter, 4/3 mm in summer

hongkong.br: Big Wave Bay (beach, beginner-intermediate, Nov-Mar); Shek O (beach, beginner-intermediate, Nov-Mar); Tai Long Wan (beach, intermediate, Nov-Mar)
hongkong.hz: Typhoon swells and rips, no lifeguards at remote Tai Long Wan, crowded weekends
hongkong.tp: 64-86 F, boardshorts in summer, 3/2 mm wetsuit in winter

mallorca.br: Playa de Muro (beach, beginner, Oct-Mar); Son Serra de Marina (reef, intermediate, Oct-Mar); Cala Ratjada (beach, intermediate-expert, Oct-Mar)
mallorca.hz: Rocks at the reef breaks, rips at Cala Ratjada, wind-driven chop, flat summers
mallorca.tp: 59-82 F, rash vest and boardshorts in summer, 4/3 mm wetsuit in winter

belfast-giants-causeway.br: Portrush East and West Strand (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Mar); Portstewart Strand (beach, intermediate, Sep-Mar); Portballintrae (reef, intermediate-expert, Sep-Mar)
belfast-giants-causeway.hz: Strong rips at Portstewart whatever the swell, very cold water, shifting banks, cars caught by the high tide on the beach
belfast-giants-causeway.tp: 43-59 F, 4/3 mm in summer, 5/4 mm hooded with boots and gloves from November to March

punta-cana.br: Encuentro (reef, beginner-intermediate, Nov-Mar); Destroyers (reef, expert, Nov-Mar); Coco Pipe (reef, expert, Nov-Mar); Playa Grande (beach, intermediate-expert, Nov-Mar)
punta-cana.hz: Urchins and shallow rocky reef, polluted water near Puerto Plata, strong currents at Playa Grande
punta-cana.tp: 77-84 F, boardshorts, a shorty wetsuit on cool winter days

faroe-islands.br: Tjørnuvík (beach, intermediate-expert, Aug-Oct); Sandoy beaches (beach, intermediate, Aug-Oct)
faroe-islands.hz: Powerful inconsistent waves, strong rips, hard landings on the open coast, freezing water, unpredictable weather
faroe-islands.tp: 43-52 F, 5/4 mm or 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit with gloves and boots
faroe-islands.pm: The one local operator rents gear only with a guided session, for safety

thailand.br: Kata (beach, beginner, May-Oct); Kalim (reef, intermediate-expert, May-Oct); Surin (beach, expert, May-Oct); Memories Beach at Khao Lak (beach, beginner, May-Oct)
thailand.hz: Shifting sandbars and drop-offs at Bang Tao, rips, shallow reef at Kalim, monsoon storms
thailand.sz: 2-4 ft; 6-10 ft on big monsoon days

madeira.br: Jardim do Mar (point, expert, Oct-Mar); Paul do Mar (reef, expert, Oct-Mar); Ponta Pequena (point, intermediate-expert, Oct-Mar); Fajã da Areia (beach, intermediate, Oct-Mar)
madeira.hz: Seawall backwash at Jardim do Mar, boulders and rocks, steep cliff-path access, broken boards on big days
madeira.sz: 6-15 ft when swells arrive; 20+ ft at Jardim do Mar on the biggest days
madeira.tp: 63-73 F, 3/2 mm wetsuit in summer, 4/3 mm in winter

olympic.br: La Push First Beach (beach, intermediate, Sep-Mar); Rialto Beach (beach, expert, Sep-Mar); Kalaloch (beach, expert, Sep-Mar)
olympic.hz: Sneaker waves, strong rips, driftwood and logs, sharp rocks, rising tides that cut off beach walks, sharks, very cold water
olympic.tp: 43-63 F, 4/3 mm in summer, 5/4 or 6/5 mm hooded with gloves and boots in winter
olympic.pm: An Olympic National Park pass is needed for the park beaches, and reports differ on whether a Quileute permit is needed at La Push First Beach, so confirm with the Quileute Nation

redwood.br: Crescent Beach near Crescent City (beach, intermediate-expert, Oct-Apr); Humboldt beach breaks (beach, intermediate-expert, Oct-Apr)
redwood.hz: Great white sharks, very cold water, strong rips and heavy shorebreak, fog, logs after storms, crab-pot lines, no lifeguards
redwood.tp: 48-57 F, 5/4 to 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit with gloves and boots all year

rivieramaya.hz: Shallow reef, flat or choppy most days, narrow beaches, strong winds and rough seas in the rainy season

santorini.hz: Strong meltemi wind, onshore wind chop rather than swell, kite and windsurf traffic
santorini.tp: 59-79 F, boardshorts in summer, a shorty wetsuit for long sessions

palawan.br: Duli Beach at El Nido (beach, beginner-intermediate, Nov-Mar); Nagtabon Beach near Puerto Princesa (beach, intermediate, Nov-Mar)
palawan.hz: Big strong waves at Nagtabon, rough access roads

puglia.hz: Rock and reef bottoms, wind that swings between the Adriatic and Ionian sides
puglia.tp: 54-79 F, rash vest and boardshorts in summer, 4/3 to 5/4 mm wetsuit in winter

jamaica.br: Copa at Bull Bay (reef, beginner-intermediate, year-round); Boston Bay (reef, beginner, Nov-Mar); Makka (reef, expert, Nov-Mar)
jamaica.hz: Shallow coral heads and urchins, rocks, hurricane swells from July to September, rough access roads

barcelona.br: Masnou (beach, intermediate, Oct-Mar); Sitges El Cementerio (reef, intermediate-expert, Oct-Mar); Barceloneta (beach, beginner, Oct-Mar)
barcelona.hz: Crowded lineups when it works, flat most of the summer, theft from beach bags
barcelona.sz: 1-3 ft; up to 5 ft in winter storms
barcelona.tp: 55-79 F, rash vest and boardshorts in summer, 4/3 to 5/4 mm wetsuit in winter
